environment_spec.name: cellquant-hpc
cuda_notes: Pin a PyTorch/CUDA/Cellpose stack compatible with Ampere A100.
CURC FAQ recommends nvhpc_sdk/2025.251 or newer across Alpine GPUs.
notes: Prefer a validated prebuilt environment when available.
Download standard Cellpose model weights during setup, not during the GPU job.
Setting QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen alone is not an installation strategy.
Explicit A100 alternative — never the silent default (H200 is recommended).
Full-GPU GRES only in this profile; A100 MIG slices belong in a separate advanced profile.
Heavy I/O belongs on /scratch/alpine; copy durable results back to /projects.
Real Alpine smoke job not yet recorded — do not claim cluster verified.
